mods.description: Vulkan rendering for Minecraft 1.8.9 with LWJGL3 support

releases.notes: Now the menu works perfectly, you can open it by pressing R-SHIFT in game. The lazy chunks loading dosnt works, dont use it. Everything else works perfectly. This mod not only boost you fps, also makes the game look better and feels smooth, you gonna notice it. This version outperforms every other minecraft fps oriented client (at least on my hardware). IF IT LOOKS STRANGE WHEN YOU SEE AT DISTANT THINGS TRY CHANGING THE MIPMAP TO 0. I wish you enjoy playing with this mod.
